info.title: @schafevormfenster/calendar-api
info.description: The calendar API delivers data related to organizers and calendars from the CRM, facilitating access to calendar events sourced from Google calendars.

get.description: Get a list of all organizers from the crm system.
get.summary: Get a list of all organizers

get.description: Get a list of organizers that were created after a specific timestamp. Supports both ISO8601 timestamps (e.g., '2024-07-26T15:20:00Z') and relative time expressions (e.g., '1d' for 1 day ago, '3h' for 3 hours ago, '30m' for 30 minutes ago).
get.summary: Get a list of newly created organizers

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Timestamp in ISO8601 format or relative time expression (e.g., '1d', '3h', '30m'). Defaults to '1d' (last 24 hours).

created_at.description: Date and time when the organizer was created

updated_at.description: Date and time when the organizer was last updated

since.description: The timestamp used to filter new organizers (normalized to ISO8601)

Get events from a google calendar.

parameters.name: timeMax
parameters.description: Default value is 90 days in the future.

id.description: Google Calendar ID where this event originates
Organizer ID from calendar API (CRM system)

fileUrlTemplate.description: Token-templated attachment URL. Uses host placeholder {calendar-api-host} and token placeholder {read-access-token} with concrete calendar/event/attachment IDs, e.g. https://{calendar-api-host}/api/{read-access-token}/calendars/<calendarId>/events/<eventId>/attachments/<attachmentId>

get.description: Get a list of calendars that were associated with organizers after a specific timestamp. Supports both ISO8601 timestamps (e.g., '2024-07-26T15:20:00Z') and relative time expressions (e.g., '1d' for 1 day ago, '3h' for 3 hours ago, '30m' for 30 minutes ago).
get.summary: Get a list of newly created calendars

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Timestamp in ISO8601 format or relative time expression (e.g., '1d', '3h', '30m'). Defaults to '1d' (last 24 hours).

get.description: Serves internal attachments as binary or redirects to external (Google Drive) URLs.

post.description: Create an event with optional Base64-encoded attachments. Organizer and calendar are resolved from the path. Returns 200 if duplicate detected.
post.summary: Create an event for an organizer.

delete.description: Delete a single event owned by an organizer with cascade attachment cleanup. Validates that the event belongs to the specified organizer.
delete.summary: Delete a single event by ID.

delete.description: Delete events by organizer, calendar, or date threshold. At least one filter is required. Use dryRun=true to preview.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Filter events ending before this date (ISO8601 or relative time, e.g. '1d', '2w')

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Filter events starting after this date (ISO8601 or relative time)

get.description: Production-only GET endpoint triggered by Vercel Cron Jobs. Deletes events with end date older than 7 days. Protected by Vercel CRON_SECRET authentication.

before.description: ISO8601 threshold date used for deletion cutoff

durationMs.description: Duration of the cleanup operation in ms

get.description: Returns the complete OpenAPI/Swagger specification for this API in JSON format. This endpoint can be used by code generators to create client SDKs.
